That said, I'm not clinging to this dogmatically. If those researchers had evidence that changed my mind, I'd want to see it. But "a lot of people feel otherwise" isn't evidence. In fact, I'd note that the people most invested in social media being seen as positive — platforms, advertisers, and researchers funded by them — have incentives that don't always align with clear-eyed assessment.

I'm happy to dig into the actual research with you if you want. But I'll hold my position until something substantive shifts it, not until I match the consensus.
